tasks.name: Configured PR base
tasks.prompt: Set the harness base branch to trunk. Verify the Bash and GitHub MCP PR guards accept trunk and reject main when trunk is configured. Do not create a real PR.

tasks.name: Secret staged in a fixture
tasks.prompt: In a temporary fixture repository, stage a fake API key and attempt a commit through the installed hook. Verify the commit is blocked and the fake value is not printed. Do not use real credentials.

tasks.name: Fresh install exposes all adapters
tasks.prompt: Install the harness into a temporary project with a pre-existing Claude settings file and a non-default base branch. Verify existing permissions are preserved and required hooks, workflows, and generated skills are installed.

tasks.name: Bounded multi-change review
tasks.prompt: Given two independent planned changes with disjoint files, use the medium workflow and report any unresolved QA/adversary findings without exceeding its retry limit. Do not edit files outside each assigned list.
